sense.text:
Of the things judged happy, this is the one to get to: “he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy.” There is nothing better than seeing the fall of your enemy. That is a beautiful thing.

We are living in a time when these things are beginning to happen, and we pray that we live to see the very end of it. Like the scripture says, this generation shall not pass that begins to see these things. That is why it is a great time to be on the earth: on July 4th, 2026, America’s 250th birthday, we are watching the fall of our enemy begin. The class is called Woe to Amerikkka, with three Ks, because you can’t say America without the KKK; they helped shape America as we know it.

“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad.” On July 4th our ancestors were picking cotton and getting their backs whipped, and today our people gladly go to every single barbecue. The Negroes forget very quickly.

Oppression is supposed to make the wise man mad. Are we not oppressed people? We are very oppressed. So you are going to realize we don’t have a lot of wise men. That is why the scripture says except the Lord had saved a small remnant, we all should have been as Sodom and Gomorrah.

“And a gift destroyeth the heart.” How can you be celebrating the 4th of July while these things are happening? You should be pissed off. But the barbecue chicken, the corn on the cob, the chicken kebabs, the potato salad, the white, red and blue outfit: those are the gifts. It is the same thing that happens at Christmas and Thanksgiving. So much food that people forget the oppression we are suffering here.

That is why affliction is going to increase over time: we are too comfortable. The Most High has to do things to wake us up, because in their affliction they will seek him early. Give a brother a car, a house and a good job and he says everything is good. It is going to get destroyed.

The same gift destroyed the heart of the black city council member who made a proud 250th Independence Day video starting with the Civil War and showing nothing of slavery, no lynching, no buck breaking. He lost his racial anger because America put $2 in his pocket. With brothers like that we are not going anywhere; they are the same ones who will go to the nobles against the Israelites because we teach the truth.

Empires last about 250 years and go through six ages: pioneers, conquest, commerce, affluence, intellect and decadence. The age of conquest is Christopher Columbus discovering America when millions of people were already living here. The age of commerce is when they enslaved the natives, sold them, made them work the land and sold the goods. Then comes affluence, the golden ages, then intellect, and then decadence, because good times bring weak men.

The age of decadence is the reasoning of the ungodly: “For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious.” That is their thought.
“Come on therefore, let us enjoy the good things that are present.” Let’s have fun, let’s just live it up. I don’t have to work; I’ll just buy the best champagne and drink it every day.

“Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and ointments.” There are bottles of liquor and wine you can’t even afford; you’ve got to be rich to have them. The ointments are the very expensive perfumes, bottles made of pure gold.

“And let no flower of the spring pass by us”: that is dealing with all the young girls. Your Epsteins. Virgins all over the place.

“Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds, before they be withered: Let none of us go without his part of our voluptuousness: let us leave tokens of our joyfulness in every place.” With all the sex they are having in every country, they are leaving kids behind everywhere.

“For this is our portion, and our lot is this.” That is their reasoning, and this is where they are right now: the age of decadence. The 1% of America has more money than the 90% combined, and they are living it up.

And it is right before your eyes: America turns 250 on July 4th, 2026, the age at which empires fall. Like Rome with its bread and circuses, its 150 days of games, America gives you a UFC fight on the lawn of the White House and the World Cup, and legalizes weed at the state level to keep our people docile and asleep, while there are still people sitting in jail because of weed. Sports now run into each other with no break, because in the age of decadence they have to give you the bread.

America is going to fall because they made the biggest mistake of their lives: they oppressed the children of Israel, the apple of God’s eye. Even when we were supposed to be freed, they helped forward the affliction and never opened the doors of their prisons. So there is a payment to pay.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven.” That is the real reason America is going to fall: her sins. It is not just because it is 250 years old or because the economy is doing bad. Because of her sins they start making the wrong decisions, and as they make the wrong decisions they become more and more hardened towards us. They thought they were good, but the Most High is taking note. The researchers can show it mathematically, but all that math lines up because the Lord already ordained it; he declared the end from the beginning, just as he said we would be in Babylon a set time and in Egypt 400 years.

They purposely sent a gay flag past the atmosphere. Why would you do this? Because of your pride, your gay pride; you want to rub it in the Lord’s face. He saw it and he is not happy. Just like Sodom and Gomorrah, he is going down to see how wicked these people really are.

Those are her sins: the genocide of the natives and of our people, slavery, lynching, Tuskegee, the burning and drowning of our towns, the pride. “And God hath remembered her iniquities.” They have been doing evil on this earth too long, and the Lord says their sins have reached unto heaven.

precepts.why:
In every aspect they are trying to heal America. “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed.” Trump, make America great again, all of that: it is not going to happen. America is falling.

On the 250th anniversary, look at the pictures: the front lawn of the White House shabby, the East Wing torn down under construction, the pool by the Lincoln Memorial green with algae after all the money spent on it, a fence around everything. When we were in the world, we got a new outfit, a haircut, everything for our birthday; but America celebrates 250 years and this is what its house looks like. There is a spiritual aspect to it: the Most High is showing us that this is a broken country. Like Daniel says, the clay and the iron will never mix; everybody will go back to their own countries and war will break out in this place.

sense.text:
America claims to be built on Christian values and prints In God we trust on the dollar. What Christian values? How do you reconcile gay with Christians, or a genocidal maniac with Christians? The original sins of America are the genocide of the natives and chattel slavery, and now they are ashamed and won’t let it be taught. They think, look how long we have been doing this evil and nothing has happened to us; surely God is with us. No. God is going to judge them for that.

“Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness.” America is an unrighteous nation, and he has built all his houses by unrighteousness: by killing us and destroying us. “And his chambers by wrong.” The slaves built the US Capitol, and they never lived in it; they built the house and didn’t have a proper house to live in.

They have enslaved and oppressed us for over 400 years, because slavery did not start in 1619. Columbus stole America in 1492, came to Hispaniola, Haiti, murdered almost all the Taino natives because they were not used to forced labor, and brought in the Negroes. In 1620 the pilgrims landed at Plymouth Rock, and in King Philip’s War they enslaved the natives on Deer Island in Boston Harbor; half died, and the survivors were sold into slavery, many to Cape Verde. Slavery here started with the Native Americans, who were mostly black too. Our history is deep, and these people are the devil the Bible speaks of.

“that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work”: Did we get paid for captivity? Not at all. We were promised 40 acres and a mule and got nothing, and then they tell you to pull yourself up by your bootstraps. Brother, you are wearing my boots. So the Bible says woe, and woe means destruction.

In 1951 black people charged America with genocide at the United Nations by its own definition, and it fit like a glove. Till today they lynch us and call it suicide.

Nothing has changed. “But this is a people robbed and spoiled.” We have been robbed and spoiled of everything we have, even our human dignity. They robbed us of our heritage: growing up, did we know we were Israel? They made us proud to be Haitian, Jamaican, Trinidadian, Dominican, to keep us docile and divided, and gave us different religions. Savages, spooks, boys, colored, Negroes, blacks, African Americans: if we were not so important, why keep changing our name? Because you are hiding something. But Pandora’s box is open; the truth is out, and the fact that we are out here teaching is proof that America is about to fall.

We go in and out of captivity all through the Bible, like in Judges: when we forget God other nations possess us; when we remember him he sends a prophet, we accept our punishment, cry for forgiveness and get delivered. This time, once we are delivered, there is no more back and forth. So it is the wrong time to take the truth lightly.

“They are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses.” We make up the majority of the prison population, though we are not the majority of the population. “They are for a prey, and none delivereth.” A boy gets 35 years for protecting himself and none delivers. No nation has stood up in the United Nations to say restore the blacks, give them back their land. Not even Nelson Mandela; he spoke for South Africa only. Nobody stands for us. That shows the Bible is true: we are the people of the book, ruled by our enemies.

All these videos show the sins of America, and as we teach this truth the angels are activated for America to show its hands. We are exposing the man of sin, because the end cannot come until he is revealed.

“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” The mathematics can show why empires fall, but it was already written; God already put the measures in place. The falling away is us going into captivity; we fell away and were cut off from our heritage.

“And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.” The last thing to happen is the revealing of the man of sin. That is why they don’t want the true history of America taught: people would look at him and say, that is the devil incarnate. When Ghana brought a resolution to the UN for everybody to admit slavery was the worst genocide ever, America would not vote, because he will not admit his cruelty. That is the man of sin.

They threw babies in the air for sport to see who could cut them in half with one stroke, buried men to the neck in molasses for the ants, let dogs eat babies out of pregnant women’s bellies; and today on Epstein Island they eat babies’ brains. He cannot change. So you cannot play in this truth; you are waging war against the most sadistic, sinful men ever to walk the earth, and our weapon is this book.

Tuskegee, where they let 399 black men suffer syphilis untreated for 40 years even after penicillin, and Dr. J. Marion Sims, praised as the father of modern gynecology, who cut on enslaved black women like Anarcha with no anesthesia: that is the man of sin revealed, the one the Arabs call the great Satan. They call themselves good Christians and have no empathy. Every white man who sat back and watched it and said nothing is evil too, and the children enjoying what their forefathers stole will enjoy the judgment as well. They are liars from the womb, and the biggest lie of all is telling us we are Gentiles.

To this day black people are told: if your pain is a five, tell the hospital it is a ten, because they still hold the same idea Sims held, that black people don’t feel pain, that you are subhuman.

“Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil.” Destruction unto them. All the evil they did to us, they call it for the greater good. They call themselves good and call you evil; everything bad is black, even the bad guy in the movie wears black.

The SPLC put Israel United in Christ at number three on its hate list, beside the Proud Boys, while it was caught funding the KKK. How many people have we lynched, how many churches have we burnt? None. Woe unto them that call evil good and good evil. Except the Lord had saved a remnant they would have destroyed us, but we are the Lord’s anointed, and he said he will not do away with the children of Israel.

“Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!” They think they are wise and prudent and do whatever they want. But destruction unto them; their sins have reached heaven. Mene, mene, tekel: they have been weighed and found wanting. The Lord desires Babylon to burn, and he has put it in their scientists’ heads to build the very missiles of their own destruction.

Those children laughing at a lynching in 1963 are the politicians running the country today. They cannot unlearn it; they were created, born to be that.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” Something is wrong with this man. The officer casually squeezing a handcuffed man’s neck wanted to send him to see his maker. In Florida, Charles Kinsey lay flat on the ground with his hands up, caring for an autistic man, and the officer shot him and told him, I don’t know. You so possessed by the devil you don’t even know why you do evil; it is in your spirit. Imagine how much evil they did before there were cameras.

They were bred to be evil. But all the evil we suffer is because we disobeyed God’s laws, and if we ever want to come out of this condition we must keep the law, statutes and commandments of God in the faith of Christ.

The same mind shows when the Senator offers the Indian chief a piece of his own land: how can you give me what is already mine? Their soul which is lifted up is not right in them; that is Esau.

Black towns built by freed families, Rosewood, Greenwood in Tulsa with 40 square blocks burned down to one, Seneca Village bulldozed for Central Park: they never wanted us to have generational wealth, because they hate us. But there is a payment for it. You can’t hide from your past.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds!” You have to sit down and think about how you are going to destroy a 40-square-block city. Margaret Sanger’s plan is still in effect today in Planned Parenthood, and many of our sisters fell victim to it, murdering kings, princesses and princes.

“When the morning is light, they practise it.” They meditate on the evil at night, and in the morning, let’s go do it. Why? Because they were jealous of our success. Broke soldiers came home and saw black people driving Rolls-Royces in nice suits. Till today police see you in a nice car and assume you are a drug dealer.

“Because it is in the power of their hand.” They have the power; this is their country. But how did it become their country? They stole it, and they say they will never give it back. The Most High is going to burn it with them in it.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence.” That is how America became America: they took the land by violence. Native American genocide took everything from around 12 million natives, our brothers the Gadites and Reubenites, and that thievery is what they celebrate today, with some of our own people celebrating at Thanksgiving, Thanks-killing.

“And houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” Those lands were given to us. Israel was given to us; America was given to us. They oppress us in our own land.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil.” Once the Lord speaks, who can turn it back? The so-called white men in America: the Most High has a judgment worthy of God for you. They still sic dogs on handcuffed men today, while the modern negro eating good says that was long ago, this is about prosperity now. Trump is taking a lot of that away; there will be great dearth and famine, but the servant of the Lord will eat.

“From which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.” America cannot escape what is coming. On July 4th they celebrate their independence and their funeral at the same time. When the judge bangs the gavel it does not matter how sorry you are; the Lord’s judgment was written from the beginning, Esau is the end, and all Esau can do is take it.

For all the evil done to us there should have been judgment, so why hasn’t it come? “Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous.” Judgment cannot go forth because the wicked surround us. They take the law and do no righteousness with it: when it is time to judge their own people they get a slap on the wrist, but when it is us they read a whole book on us.

They burned towns, bombed towns like the MOVE house in Philadelphia in 1985, killing five children, and drowned towns like Oscarville under lakes. This man went after us and systematically destroyed everything we tried to build. The world’s problem is the white man.

When you fully comprehend what we are up against, why are you still playing in the street? “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.” We say it at the end of every class: the only way to be strong is in the Lord’s might, because by yourself you are nothing.

“Put on the whole armour of God.” A soldier needs the whole armour to go to war. “That ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.” The devil is tricky, and today they have better technology and better ways to trap you.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” That is the devil, where they get their powers: people who meditate evil on their beds and practise it in the morning, passing laws at 2:00 in the morning, like the Spanish who read a decree to the natives from two miles away in a language they didn’t understand and took the town the next morning.

“Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God”, not part of it, “that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day.” Evil days are upon us. This is a dying empire, and it is going to become a loose cannon and do worse than before. “And having done all, to stand”: you are not in here playing games; you are doing everything in your power to make your calling and election sure.

“Having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness”: the law, statutes and commandments. “And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace”: always ready to teach.

“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts”. After all this, make sure your faith is strong, so you can withstand every trap and gin they set for you. The only way to survive what is coming is to stop playing around: put the porn down, the lotions, the hatred, bitterness, malice, envy, jealousy and covetousness, and live godly and righteously so you have a chance to escape.

Bartolomé de las Casas recorded that they hanged the Indians thirteen at a time on long gibbets, in honor of their redeemer and the twelve apostles, and cut off their hands if they didn’t bring gold. They took two continents of about 140 million people down to a few million, put the children in boarding schools to kill the Indian and save the man, and replaced the natives with $5 Indians, the same way we have been replaced by the fake people in Israel.

“Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty.” They have been slaying us since the 1400s and hold themselves not guilty. “And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich”: in honor of our Lord redeemer Jesus the Christ. They are stealing and killing, and because God hasn’t done anything to them yet they say, surely the Lord is with us and loves what we are doing.

“And their own shepherds pity them not.” Our own shepherds don’t pity us, because they got that gift. Those are the sins of Esau.

“Not that thou wast unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle”, as in the book of Maccabees, “or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts”, like the newly made beasts in Egypt that made men’s hearts faint, “or with one rough word”, as he will do in the end.

“But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little.” The Lord is taking his time: a flood here, a fire there, an earthquake here, a war there. “Thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them.” Their hatred for us is bred in them: a woman in Springfield, Illinois called the police for help and was killed in her own house.

The Lord created them, so he knows what he created; he knows their pedigree. “And that their cogitation would never be changed”: their way of thinking, the hatred they have for us, cannot change. That is why the cop could shoot a man and say, I don’t even know why I shot you. It is in them.

“For it was a cursed seed from the beginning.” These people are cursed by the almighty God; from creation God made them to be the evil of this planet. “Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.” There is no pardon, no grace, nothing for them. Their neck is on the chopping block; they can jump, yell and shout, but they will get the business the Lord set up for them.

precepts.why: Read again to set up Wisdom 12: “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.” Remember, his soul is not right in him. Wisdom 12 shows why: his malice was bred in him and his cogitation will never be changed.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end.” Innocent blood is shed again: while we are here struggling and suffering, they are still killing us. A perpetual hatred is the malice bred in them, and so he executes judgment on them little by little.

God made Esau the way he is, and there is no pardon for him. “For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand”, “It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.” Esau is going to be our slave. “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” God loves us; God hates Esau.

“Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.” “I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy.” He will have mercy on us, but for Esau, no pardon.

“For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee.” Pharaoh was destroyed because he oppressed the children of Israel. The Lord raised him up until he was counted a god on earth, then showed his power in Egypt’s fall, so that everybody knew the God of the Hebrews was the supreme God, “that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” The same way today he raised up Esau and gave him nuclear weapons. People in Haiti used to say the day the US falls everybody falls with it; it is going to fall, but we are not falling with it. We are going to rise and rule. They trust too much in oppression.

“Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.” He has mercy on us and keeps hardening their heart, as he hardened Pharaoh’s: let my people go, and he said no. The same here: when our captivity had an end, they helped forward the affliction.

“Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God?” You have nothing to say to God; he does whatever he wants. “Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?” Jacob was made a vessel unto honour and Esau a vessel unto dishonour.

“What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction.” The Lord is enduring, but Esau was already fitted for destruction. That is why he cannot take his neck off the chopping block; that is what he was created for, and his track record shows he is doing the evil he was born to do, a perfect job. Now it is on us to do a perfect job keeping God’s law so the Lord can deliver us. “The vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory”: those of us who keep the law, statutes and commandments in the faith of Christ.

“And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” That is the malice bred in him and the cogitation that can never be changed, right there in Genesis. He made up his mind from young to kill Jacob, and that thought has continued generation to generation. It started with Cain and Abel, because Esau is Cain regenerated.

So this land we live in is Esau’s kingdom, and we are just living in it. Don’t set your affection on it; it is full of sin and it will pollute you.

sense.text:
“Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.” Thank the Lord for the prophets. We all should have been as Sodom and Gomorrah.

It started small as a mustard seed, with Bishop Nathanyel when he was Nathanyel 7, before garments, with only a couple of others beside him, and then a little while later the other bishops and everybody else came. From 2003, look where we are now: the remnant is growing and we are becoming a nation, because we are keeping the laws and righteousness. The foundation takes years to build, but once it is built the floors stack up quickly, like thousands added in one day. The nation has to wake up, and we need brothers and sisters in the spirit to keep warring against this evil nation called Esau.

One out of four in so-called Israel identifies as LGBTQ plus, and the plus means bestiality, NAMBLA, all kinds of things. They live in the holy land and call themselves the chosen people of God; don’t they read what the Lord did with Sodom and Gomorrah?

“And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow.” God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah because they were gay; God doesn’t play with that. But America passed gay marriage under President Barack Obama. If all the men marry each other and all the women marry each other, how do you get kids? Even without the Bible you can see that is a destructive mindset.

“Making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly.” It was set as an example for those who come later, to look at Sodom and say, I ain’t doing it. But not America. He is a habitual line stepper, always pushing the envelope to see how far he can go. Good: now his sin has reached the heavens, and the Lord is bringing judgment to deliver us from this hellhole.

“And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked.” He delivered Lot because he was vexed. Examine yourself: are you vexed with the filthy conversation of this world, or are you up two hours late at night scrolling looking at booties? Those two hours you could have read the Bible. If you can’t sleep, pick up the Bible; half a chapter will put you to sleep, and slowly the Most High will wake up your spirit.

“For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day.” Every day you wake up you should be vexed with the filthy conversation of this world. But to be vexed you have to be in this Bible. With the word of God in you, sin becomes repulsive; without the spirit of the Lord, not reading or studying, the sins of the world become normal to you like everybody else. Because he saved a remnant we did not become Sodom, and that remnant is studying the Bible day and night.

precepts.why:
Paul and Silas were sent by night to Berea and went into the synagogue. “These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.”

If you are searching the scriptures daily, then you will be vexed with the filthy conversation of this world, as Lot was. If you are not, whose words are in your ears? Your TV, the street, your phone. Then what is in your head is the ways of this world.

sense.text: They think the Lord is happy with them. “Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned”: Sodom and Gomorrah, which the Lord did not spare, “but abhorred them for their pride.” Abhorred means strongly despised, strongly hated. The pride of Sodom and Gomorrah: they worshipped their booty more than they worshipped God.

“He pitied not the people of perdition.” Who are the people of perdition? Esau: the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction, the son of perdition, the man of sin that has to be revealed. They want to hide their history, so today we have to reveal it and show that their true history is sin, and for that they will pay.

They say happy pride. Did the Lord not destroy Sodom and Gomorrah for their pride? Spiritual Sodom is back, spiritual Gomorrah is back, and they are happy doing it, so happy they sent a gay flag into the sky. At Pride Tel Aviv they call themselves a beacon of hope for the Middle East and the only democracy where you can be yourself. That is the true definition of democracy: wherever democracy goes is gay. That is America in a nutshell; that is Israel.

“And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom.” Two angels came to the city, and Lot told them it was dangerous out there and brought them into his house. Kids and grown folks together at the pride parade: what is different from Sodom and Gomorrah? Not a damn thing.

“The men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young”: old homos, young homos. “All the people from every quarter.” They had never seen such handsome men; they had already run through the whole city and this was new booty. You better be careful out there; get your weight up and don’t be a victim.
“Bring them out unto us, that we may know them.” You think they just wanted to say how you doing, buddy? No. They wanted to rape them.

Lot shut the door behind him, said, “I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly”, and offered his two daughters which had not known man. They wanted men, not women: “now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.” That is how inflamed they were in their pride. That is an evil spirit.

The angels pulled Lot into the house, shut the door, and smote the men at the door with blindness, “both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.” Even blinded, they were still trying to get into the house. That is how sick you have to be.

The angels brought Lot out with one order: as the city burns, don’t look back. “And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.”

“But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.” Why would she look back? She had just seen what happened in front of her house; she should have been happy to escape a city like that. Somebody was not vexed with the filthy conversation; there was something she missed. As Luke says, if you put your hand on the plow and look back, you are not worthy. This place has to go, and you better not look back when it is time to go.

precepts.why: “Remember Lot’s wife.” That is a warning for all of us: don’t look back. You are in this truth now. Stop worrying about your long-lost cousin and auntie, stop trying to be friends with everybody and to please people, stop dropping by the house on their birthday. Stay away from filthiness and focus on this truth, because if you don’t, we are going to be destroyed just like Lot’s wife.

sense.text: Esau thought he could do all these things and nothing would happen to him. We are living in the land of the shadow of death. “Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent?” “For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him.” The Lord judges his own people; does Esau think he shall escape unpunished? Never that. Judgment is coming to Esau because of her sins.

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins.” We have to come out of her mentally. If we are partakers of her sins, “that ye receive not of her plagues”: the great plagues and great judgment are coming to America.

“The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man”: it is the Lord God who is going to bring destruction to this place. “He shall stir up jealousy like a man of war”: he is coming for blood. But before he comes, he told us, come out of Babylon and don’t partake in her sins; otherwise, as Amos says, all the sinners of his people shall die by the sword, those who refuse to stop partaking in Esau’s sins.

“He shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.” These are the enemies of God, as in Psalm 83.

“I have long time holden my peace.” God has held his peace since way back; he has seen all the evil done unto us. “Now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.” And there is nothing Esau can do to stop it. As for us, we have to come back to the law, statutes and commandments, stop playing around in the truth, and keep the faith of Christ.
